say:0:1012511101:0.text: That cursed Eomir! He doesn't dare face us head-on!
say:0:1012511101:0.source_cn: 伊米尔那个混蛋！不敢正面和我们对峙，跑得倒是比谁都快！

say:1:1012511102:0.text: The lady we saw talking to Eomir just now used teleportation magic!
say:1:1012511102:0.source_cn: 刚才咱们看到的那个和伊米尔谈话的女士，她用了传送魔法！

say:2:1012511103:0.text: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, do you remember that type of magic?

say:3:1012511104:0.text: She must have been the one that teleported Eomir away at the Lucent Tree!
say:3:1012511104:0.source_cn: 在流荧树下用传送魔法把伊米尔救走的人，肯定也是她！

say:4:1012511105:0.text: The Adamant Syndicate... first Ryeham, and now the Dark Forest. What are they planning?
say:4:1012511105:0.source_cn: 黑金商会……先是金穗村，又是薄暮丛林的生命力，他们到底...
say:4:1012511105:0.male: The Adamant Syndicate... first Ryeham, and now the Dark Forest. What are they planning?
say:4:1012511105:0.female: The Adamant Syndicate... first Ryeham, and now the Dark Forest. What are they planning?
